techniques.title: Splunk app upload with scripted input → RCE
preconditions: free license (remote 8089 login disabled) OR usable web creds (default admin:changeme, or no-auth)
techniques.notes: Free license disables remote login on the 8089 management port but the web app-upload on 8000 still works. A custom app with a scripted input (inputs.conf [script://...]) runs code as the 'splunk' OS user. Default credential is admin:changeme.
validate_steps: Browse http://{target}:8000/en-US/manager/launcher/apps/local to confirm app management is reachable.
Determine license (free vs enterprise) and whether login is required; free + web upload = exploitable.
Check default credential admin:changeme on the web login (single attempt, approval + scope).
exploit_steps: Write app/bin/rev.py: a Python reverse shell to {lhost}:{lport}.
Upload app.tar.gz via http://{target}:8000/en-US/manager/.../apps/local (Install app from file).
Start a listener (nc -lvnp {lport}); the scripted input executes as the splunk user within ~interval seconds.
